pages.text: I can strip the flesh from a zombie without merely killing it.

$(bold)Mana:$() ¼ bucket$(br)$(bold)Mode:$() Instant$(br2)Aim at a Zombie within twelve blocks. It is replaced by a Skeleton at the same location and additional Rotten Flesh is produced. The transformation avoids also granting the zombie’s ordinary death loot.
pages.title: Method and Limits
